label: run73 chp floor petra
definition: Run73 (from Run-72): (1) CHP steam-floor fix — grid floor now spread across econ smoothing slices instead of clipped to the first (Sweeny 48->185 MW, Bayou 20->104 MW, Deer Park/Baytown CC_CHP floors also unclipped). (2) Petra Nova (58378) reclassified on its own: single tranche at net-of-capture-parasitic capacity (40%) forced to 92% CF whenever the outage overlay says on — 45Q makes it price-insensitive. (3) CT_PEAKER committed 1.30->1.10, econ_high 2.08->2.18. (4) ST_GAS peak 4.20->3.20 (steam-gas peaking band too dear). (5) COAL_PRB committed 0.75->0.65, econ_low 0.50->0.40, econ_high 1.33->1.38, peak 1.455->1.505 (2024 PRB -15.5%% under-run vs only modest gas-price delta 2023->2024). (6) CC_REGULAR -0.05 across all bands (committed 0.87, econ_low 1.06, econ_high 1.26, peak 2.20).
